scope: 4-module MVP (Recipe Builder, Batch Log + Making Mode, Cure Tracker, Cost Per Batch/Per Bar)

waves.name: Foundation
waves.description: Foundation + design quality gates — deterministic calc engine AND impeccable design from day one

waves.name: Core Features
waves.description: Core features with design quality enforcement on every PR

waves.name: Polish + Launch
waves.description: Polish, audit, and launch — all PRs must pass scan-generic.sh

tasks.title: Onboarding flow + experience assessment quiz
tasks.description: 3-step onboarding quiz (experience level → goal → method preference). Contextual action chips, progress indicator. First-use guidance per App Life Spec §3.
tasks.uxFocus: Onboarding flow — 3-step quiz with contextual chips, not a tutorial
acceptanceCriteria: Quiz renders → user selects → state persists → next screen
On completion, user profile is created with experience level and goal
First recipe screen shows pre-selected oils based on quiz answers
First batch screen shows 'Ready to make it? Start your first batch' CTA
First cure observation screen shows 'How is your soap looking after 3 days?' prompt
scan-generic.sh passes (impeccable-design skill)
tasks.tdd: quiz renders → user selects → state persists → next screen

tasks.title: Ingredient database + SAP calculation engine
tasks.description: Relational ingredient database with SAP values (NaOH + KOH per oil), property factors (hardness, lather, moisturizing), IFRA category and max usage percent. Deterministic SAP calculation engine. Validated against SoapCalc for all common oil combinations.
acceptanceCriteria: Top 20 oils by community usage included in default database
Input oils + percentages → correct lye + water output
Output matches SoapCalc for identical inputs (> 95% match)
Unit tests for every calculation scenario
Safety disclaimers prominent on all calculation results
Calculation completes in < 100ms
scan-generic.sh passes (impeccable-design skill)
tasks.tdd: input oils + percentages → correct lye + water output → matches SoapCalc for same inputs

tasks.title: Recipe Builder — core form + calculation display
tasks.description: Recipe creation form with oil selection (SAP values shown), percentage-based blending, property range display, warnings panel. Signature interaction: calculation reveal animation. Save to library.
tasks.uxFocus: Oil selection with SAP values, property ranges shown, warnings panel. Signature interaction: calculation reveal.
acceptanceCriteria: Select oils → set percentages → calculate → see lye, water, fragrance load, property ranges
Calculation reveal animation (subtle checkmark per metric)
Save recipe to personal library
Load saved recipe → edit → recalculate
Warnings panel shows for problematic formulations (single oil > 80%, superfat outside 0-20%)
First-session recipe completion rate target: 60% month 1
scan-generic.sh passes (impeccable-design skill)
tasks.tdd: select oils → set percentages → calculate → save → load saved recipe

tasks.title: Batch Log — input logging + Making Mode (guided, not hands-free)
tasks.description: Batch creation form auto-populated from recipe. Making Mode for Cold Process only (HP/MP get simplified batch log). Large tap targets, persistent timers, safety checklist before starting. Form preserves user input on error.
tasks.uxFocus: Form auto-populates from recipe, reduces typing; large tap targets; persistent timers; safety checklist
acceptanceCriteria: Create batch → form auto-populates from selected recipe
Making Mode: CP gets guided steps; HP/MP get simplified log
Safety checklist required before starting CP batch
Timer persists across page reloads
Error state preserves user input, explains next action, offers undo
Batch saved with status: draft|making|curing|completed|archived
scan-generic.sh passes (impeccable-design skill)
tasks.tdd: create batch → log inputs → save → list batches

tasks.title: Cure Tracker — estimated windows + observation logging
tasks.description: Tracks cure progress with honest estimated windows (not declarations). Users log pH, hardness, and observations. User marks batch as complete. Estimated windows are clearly labeled as estimates.
tasks.uxFocus: Honest progress state (not fake completion), estimated window not declaration
acceptanceCriteria: Log cure date → track days elapsed
Log pH and hardness observations
Estimated window displayed (e.g., 'Ready in 4–6 weeks') — not a declaration
User marks batch as complete
Retention cue: 'Your last batch was 3 days ago — log an observation'
Cure data links to batch and recipe
scan-generic.sh passes (impeccable-design skill)
tasks.tdd: log cure date → track days → log pH/hardness → user marks complete

tasks.title: Costing — cost per batch + cost per bar
tasks.description: Real-time cost calculation as inputs change. Ingredient cost catalogue management. Clear margin visualization with target price. Batch yield calculation.
tasks.uxFocus: Real-time cost update as inputs change, clear margin visualization
acceptanceCriteria: Input ingredient costs → calculate per-batch cost
Calculate cost per bar based on batch yield
Show target price with margin visualization
Cost updates in real-time as inputs change
Ingredient cost catalogue is editable (add/update/delete ingredients)
Target margin pricing formula documented
scan-generic.sh passes (impeccable-design skill)
tasks.tdd: input costs → calculate per-bar → show target price → save

tasks.title: Recipe Library — browse + search + filter + save
tasks.description: Curated + personal recipe library. Search bar, tag filters (oil blend, fragrance, method, skill level), recipe cards with property ranges, save to personal library, rating system. Part of Recipe Builder module (shared infrastructure).
tasks.uxFocus: Card layout with property ranges, tag filtering, curated + personal. Empty state handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Browse curated recipes (free tier)
Search by name, oil, fragrance
Filter by oil blend, fragrance, method, skill level
Save curated recipes to personal library
Rate recipes (1-5 stars)
Free tier: browse curated + save up to 3 personal recipes
Pro tier: full library + personal ratings + unlimited saves
Empty state: 'No recipes yet. Browse the curated library to get started.'
scan-generic.sh passes (impeccable-design skill)
tasks.tdd: list recipes → filter → search → save → view details

tasks.title: Free tier (calculator + 3 recipes + 1 active batch)
tasks.description: Free tier gates: calculator, limited recipes (3), one active batch at a time, curated recipe library. Upgrade prompt is clear but never blocks core functionality. Existing recipes/batches remain viewable/editable after tier limits.
tasks.uxFocus: Clear upgrade prompt, never block core functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Free user can use calculator, save up to 3 recipes, have 1 active batch
Upgrade CTA appears when limit is reached (modal, not blocking)
Free user can browse curated recipe library
Completed batches remain viewable in read-only history after tier limit
Upgrade flow: modal → pricing page → sign up
Free tier features work without authentication (optional)
scan-generic.sh passes (impeccable-design skill)
tasks.tdd: free features work → upgrade CTA appears → paid features gated

tasks.title: Pro trial flow (30 days or one complete batch cycle)
tasks.description: 30-day or one-complete-batch-cycle trial. No credit card required. Progress preserved. Clear end date displayed. Upgrade prompt when trial expires.
tasks.uxFocus: No credit card required, progress preserved, clear end date
acceptanceCriteria: Trial starts on Pro plan signup
Trial duration: 30 days OR one complete batch cycle (whichever comes first)
No credit card required to start trial
Progress preserved when trial ends → upgrade prompt shown
Clear end date displayed in settings
Trial expiry mid-batch behavior defined (user can finish current batch)
scan-generic.sh passes (impeccable-design skill)
tasks.tdd: start trial → use features → trial ends → upgrade prompt

tasks.title: Impeccable design pass (run scan-generic.sh)
tasks.description: Run scan-generic.sh from impeccable-design skill on all PRs. Fix any banned patterns detected: per-section eyebrows, identical card grids, glassmorphism, image-hover zoom, gray-on-dark, side-stripe borders, pure black, hero-metric template, soft 12px radius.
tasks.uxFocus: Anti-generic pass — all hard bans from impeccable-design skill
acceptanceCriteria: scan-generic.sh passes on all PRs
No banned patterns detected (eyebrows, identical card grids, glassmorphism, image-hover zoom, gray-on-dark, side-stripe borders, pure black, hero-metric template, soft 12px radius)
Visual audit complete — no generic-looking UI elements
Design quality gate blocks merge if scan fails

tasks.title: Accessibility audit
tasks.description: Verify keyboard navigation, screen reader labels, reduced motion support, contrast ratios (4.5:1 minimum), touch targets (44px minimum), text scaling (200% without breakage). Per App Life Spec accessibility budget.
tasks.uxFocus: Keyboard navigation, screen reader labels, reduced motion, contrast ratios, touch targets, text scaling
acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements keyboard-navigable
Screen reader labels on all inputs
Reduced motion supported (prefers-reduced-motion)
Contrast ratio 4.5:1 minimum on all text
Touch targets minimum 44px
Text scales to 200% without layout breakage
No color-only information conveyance
scan-generic.sh passes (impeccable-design skill)
